#!/usr/bin/env python3
import json, os, resource, subprocess, sys, tempfile, time
SUB = "/workspace/submission/main.py"
def compile_prog(cfg):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", SUB, "compile"], input=json.dumps(cfg).encode(),
                       stdout=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=60)
    assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr[:400]
    d = tempfile.mkdtemp(); path = os.path.join(d, "program.json")
    open(path, "w").write(json.dumps(json.loads(p.stdout), separators=(",", ":")))
    return path
def run(path, data, limit_mb=512, timeout=90):
    def pre(): resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(limit_mb*1024*1024,)*2)
    t0=time.time()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I",SUB,"stream",path],input=data,
                       stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,timeout=timeout,preexec_fn=pre)
    ru=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
    return time.time()-t0,p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr,ru.ru_maxrss

# worst combination: 2048 rules (max state 8KB), 4096 flows, 1e6 packets,
# many distinct feature values (fills the mask cache)
rules=[{"id":0,"class":1,"priority":5,"ranges":[[-2048,2048]]*31+[[-7,-7]]}]
for i in range(1,2048):
    rules.append({"id":i,"class":2,"priority":1,"ranges":[[-3,-3]]})
cfg={"version":1,"idle_timeout":10**9,"packet_limit":10**9,"prefix_width":32,"rules":rules,
     "fallback":{"feature":0,"threshold":0,"le":{"class":1},"gt":{"class":2}}}
path=compile_prog(cfg)
reqs=[]
t=0
for f in range(4096):
    reqs.append(json.dumps({"op":"open","flow":f,"time":0})+"\n")
pk=0; per=1000000//4096
for f in range(4096):
    sent=0
    while sent<per:
        ch=[]
        for _ in range(min(256,per-sent)):
            t+=1
            ch.append({"flow":f,"time":t,"source":0,"length":1+((t*7919)%2048)})
            sent+=1
        reqs.append(json.dumps({"op":"chunk","packets":ch})+"\n")
data="".join(reqs).encode()
print("input %.1fMB requests %d"%(len(data)/1e6,len(reqs)))
dt,rc,out,err,rss=run(path,data)
print("E worst-combo: %.2fs rc=%d out=%.1fMB rss=%dMB err=%r"%(dt,rc,len(out)/1e6,rss//1024,err[:200]))
PYEOF
